recipe.name: BN-DLC(DLCTOP)
recipe.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<Recipe>
	<Description type="Sputtering">
		<Title>Cleaning</Title>
		<Author>APS</Author>
		<Created>2026-04-08</Created>
		<Modified>2026-09-19</Modified>
		<Notes>Substrate cleaning recipe</Notes>
	</Description>
	<Parameters>
		<Group name="Parameters">
			<Param name="CleaningTime" caption="Cleaning Time" unit="sec" type="float">60</Param>
			<Param name="P" caption="Pressure" unit="mTorr" type="float">2mT</Param>
			<Param name="PowerBN" caption="PowerBN" unit="W" type="float">134</Param>
			<Param name="TimeBN" caption="TimeBN" unit="s" type="float">50</Param>
			<Param name="Bias" caption="Bias" unit="V" type="float">8</Param>
			<Param name="Warmuptime" caption="Warmuptime" unit="s" type="float">500</Param>
			<Param name="N" caption="N" unit="" type="float">46</Param>
			<Param name="CurrentC" caption="CurrentC" unit="mA" type="float">312</Param>
			<Param name="TimeC" caption="TimeC" unit="s" type="float">190</Param>
			<Param name="TimeCtop" caption="TimeCtop" unit="s" type="float">340</Param>
		</Group>
	</Parameters>
	<Script>start
#region Set gas
valve M3 open
valve M2 open
valve M1 open
valve VI open
valve V6 open
wait 60s
valve V2 open
valve V3 open
mfc Ar1 40
mfc Ar2 40
pwait pm 1.5mT 120
#endregion
#region Cleaning
message "Set Ion current to 0.1A. Ready for cleaning"
holder Ion
deposit Ion $CleaningTime 1
holder 1
message "Done. Set Ion current to 0"
#endregion
#region Deposition
valve VI close
pwait pm 2mT 120
bias set 1 Curr 0.5
bias set 1 Freq 10
bias set 1 Duty 50
bias set 1 Delay 0
set DC4001A Frequency 20
set DC4001A DutyCycle 3
set DC4001A Pulse 1
set DC4001A Current $CurrentC
power DC4001A on
set RF601 Power $PowerBN
power RF601 on
valve VI open
wait $Warmuptime "warmup"
valve VI close
valve V5 open
holder BN
bias out 1 Arb $Bias

loop $N
holder C
deposit C $TimeC 1
holder BN
deposit BN $TimeBN 1
endloop
holder C
deposit C $TimeCtop 1
holder 1

bias out 1 Arb 0
power RF601 off
set RF601 Power 0
power DC4001A off
set DC4001A Current 0
pwait pm 0 1
#endregion
valve M3 close
valve M2 close
valve M1 close
valve V6 close
valve V5 close
mfc Ar1 0
mfc Ar2 0
valve V3 close
valve V2 close
state idle
finish</Script>
</Recipe>
